jobs.description:
As a customer service representative polish/czech, you are the first point of contact for our customers from Eastern Europe. You work full-time (40 hours per week) in a dynamic and international environment. You manage customer inquiries, process orders, and handle aftersales. You have plenty of opportunities to develop yourself through training and career advancement. The position is permanent and you work in a hybrid setup: partly at the office in Leiden/Leiderdorp, partly from home.

You start your working day by reviewing open customer inquiries and checking order statuses. Then you answer emails and phone calls in Polish, Czech, or Slovak and actively think along with the customer for the best solution. You coordinate with colleagues in sales, purchasing, and logistics to ensure everything runs smoothly. You also process orders in the ERP and CRM system and prepare international transport documentation.

Are you ready to make a difference as a customer service representative polish/czech with your knowledge and enthusiasm? Apply now and discover how you can contribute to our export team!

- 

- At least mbo level of working and thinking

- 2 to 5 years of experience in a similar customer service or sales support role

- Fluent command of Polish, Czech, or Slovak and English

- Experience with ERP and CRM systems (such as SAP)

- Knowledge of export procedures and international transport documentation is a plus

Looking for a stable full-time job with a good salary and great benefits?

Then this could be the job for you!

We are looking for motivated Warehouse Workers to join the DHL Supply Chain team in Weert. No long experience needed – you will receive training on the job and have plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

Full-time availability – You are available to work 40 hours per week. Dayshift & 2-shifts available.

Own transportation – You can travel to and from the workplace independently.

English skills – You can communicate in English at work.

Reliable and motivated – You are dependable, willing to work hard and enjoy working in team.

As a warehouse operator, you will work in a dynamic logistics environment where chilled and frozen products are stored and distributed for various clients. You will work within fixed shifts: 07:00 to 18:00, 09:00 to 19:00, and 14:00 to 23:00 or 00:00. At the start, you can indicate your preference for two out of the three shifts. Based on your preference, you will be scheduled as much as possible in one fixed shift, providing structure and clarity in your working week.

In this role, you are responsible for maintaining an efficient and safe flow of goods within the warehouse. You will operate a reach truck daily to move pallets and pick orders. In addition, you will be involved in loading and unloading trucks, receiving and checking incoming goods, and managing stock locations. You will work with scanners and a modern WMS system, ensuring all processes are registered in real time and the logistics operation runs smoothly. You will also perform regular inventory checks and ensure all administrative processes are accurate. As you will be working in a chilled and frozen warehouse environment, appropriate workwear is provided to ensure you can work safely and comfortably. You are responsible for maintaining product quality and food safety by storing and handling goods at the correct temperatures and following FIFO and LIFO procedures.

With your accuracy, work pace, and sense of responsibility, you are an essential part of the logistics process and contribute directly to a reliable supply chain.

Do you want to work in a stable logistics organization where your efforts truly matter? Apply now and we will contact you shortly.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English 
- Experience with order picking
- Forklift or Reach truck certificate 
- You are a team player and work accurately and safely
